title: Italian defense figure in Sorensen story identified as Frank Carlucci

tellings.quote: I'm friends with a couple of really good researchers who think that the Italian guy is Frank Carluchi.

plain: There is a story linked to a man named Sorensen, set in Palmdale, California, in 1988, and it features an unnamed Italian figure from the defense world. Michels says that a couple of researchers he calls "really good", whom he does not name, think this Italian man is Frank Carlucci, a US defense figure whom the telling connects to the Carlyle Group, an investment firm. If they are right, it would put a senior name at the center of the story.
